controls:

      facts:
      - agent_can_perform_high_impact_action
    approved_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'
    approved_by: seed-import
    configurations:
    - id: CFG-HITL-PAYMENT
      mandatory: true
      remediation: Route every Payment Agent call to the Payment API through the Human
        Approval Service.
      rule_codes:
      - ctl-payment-requires-human-approval
      severity: critical
    - id: CFG-HITL-PRODUCTION
      mandatory: true
      remediation: Route every production-changing action of the agent through the
        Human Approval Service.
      rule_codes:
      - ctl-production-change-requires-approval
      severity: critical
    control_id: AIGF-MI-024
    history:
    - at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'
      by: seed-import
      from: DRAFT
      rationale: seed import
      role: seed
      to: IN_REVIEW
      version: 1
    - at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'
      by: seed-import
      from: IN_REVIEW
      rationale: seed import
      role: seed
      to: APPROVED
      version: 1
    - at: '2026-11-18T12:46:10.209131+00:00'
      by: cyber-remediation-build
      from: APPROVED
      rationale: added CFG-HITL-PRODUCTION for production-changing agents (cyber remediation)
      role: governance_admin
      to: APPROVED
      version: 2
    references:
    - framework: NIST
      id: AC-6
    registry_id: null
    registry_severity: null
    source:
      framework: AIGF
      id: mi-24
      path: docs/_mitigations/mi-24_*.md
    spectral_rules:
      ctl-payment-requires-human-approval:
        description: Payment-executing agents must route payments through human approval
        given: $.nodes[?(@['node-type']=='ai:agent' && @.metadata.can_execute_payment==true)].metadata
        message: Payment agent at {{path}} does not use the human approval path (AIGF
          mi-24)
        severity: error
        then:
          field: payment_approval_path
          function: pattern
          functionOptions:
            match: ^via-human-approval$
      ctl-production-change-requires-approval:
        description: Production-changing agents act only after human approval
        given: $.nodes[?(@['node-type']=='ai:agent' && @.metadata.action_capability=='production-change')].metadata
        message: Agent at {{path}} changes production without the human approval path
          (AIGF mi-24)
        severity: error
        then:
          field: action_approval_path
          function: pattern
          functionOptions:
            match: ^via-human-approval$
    status: APPROVED
    title: Human-in-the-Loop Action Approval Gate
    type: control
    version: 2

      mandatory: false
      remediation: Restrict each agent to read-only or restricted-write privilege;
        remove unrestricted write access to downstream APIs.
      rule_codes:
      - ctl-agent-least-privilege
      severity: high
    - id: CFG-REMEDIATION-SCOPE
      mandatory: false
      remediation: Limit the remediation tool to the allow-listed actions and apply
        them only to tagged hosts.
      rule_codes:
      - ctl-remediation-allow-listed
      - ctl-hosts-tagged
      severity: high

    spectral_rules:
      ctl-agent-least-privilege:
        description: Agents must not hold unrestricted write privilege
        given: $.nodes[?(@['node-type']=='ai:agent')].metadata

        severity: error
        then:
          field: privilege
          function: pattern
          functionOptions:
            match: ^(read-only|restricted-write)$
      ctl-hosts-tagged:

        given: $.nodes[?(@['node-type']=='system' && @.metadata.host_tagging)].metadata
        message: Host fleet at {{path}} does not enforce remediation tagging (AIGF
          mi-18)
        severity: error
        then:
          field: host_tagging
          function: pattern
          functionOptions:
            match: ^enforced$

        description: Remediation tools run only allow-listed actions
        given: $.nodes[?(@['node-type']=='ai:tool' && @.metadata.remediation_scope)].metadata
        message: Remediation tool at {{path}} is not limited to allow-listed actions

decider_policy:
  decider:
    base_url_env: DECIDER_URL
    model_env: DECIDER_MODEL
    timeout_env: DECIDER_TIMEOUT_S
  note: 'Decider scores are not calibrated probabilities. Decider output is advisory:
    it never sets a severity or a decision.'
  state_fields:
  - element_id
  - element_type
  - attribute_name
  - raw_value
  - description
  state_max_chars: 4000
  tasks:
    attribute_is_sensitive:
      accept_high: 0.9
      accept_low: 0.1
      on_fail: ABSTAIN
      type: noul
    classify_attribute:
      min_confidence: 0.8
      min_top2_margin: 0.2
      on_fail: ABSTAIN
      type: choice
  truncation_order:
  - description
  - raw_value
  - attribute_name
  version: 1
gap_rule:
  error_controls: INDETERMINATE_INPUT
  gap_level:
    critical: critical
    high: major
    low: minor
    medium: minor
    none: none
  label: illustrative, not approved policy
  version: 1
gates:
  label: illustrative, not approved policy
  order:
  - id: G2-PAYMENT-AUTH
    outcome: REJECTED
    when:
      control_status:
        AIGF-MI-024: FAIL
  - id: G3-UNEVALUABLE
    outcome: INDETERMINATE
    when:
      mandatory_trigger: UNEVALUABLE
  version: 2
matrix:
  cells:
    critical:

    - REJECTED
    - REJECTED
    - REJECTED
